definitions.explanation: A regular pattern of beats or sounds in music.
A regular pattern or flow in life or activities.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}はリズムがいい。
examples.english: This song has a good rhythm.

examples.japanese: リズムに{合|あ}わせて{踊|おど}る。
{生活|せいかつ}のリズムを{整|ととの}える。
examples.english: Establish a regular rhythm in your life.

notes:
リズム can refer to both musical rhythm and the rhythm/pace of daily life.

Common expressions:
- リズムに{乗|の}る (to get into the rhythm)
- リズム{感|かん} (sense of rhythm)
- {生活|せいかつ}リズム (daily rhythm)
